title: Snare · discovered

sourceRecords.title: 4 · Goblin trail and traps
read: The goblin trail narrows under the trees. Broken twigs and churned earth show several small creatures passed this way, with heavier marks among them. The road disappears behind you.

Each disturbed patch offers a place to slow down and look, while the thicker growth limits what you can see ahead. You can keep the heavier marks in view, check the ground before committing your weight, or pause to decide how closely you want to follow.

brief: DISCOVERED goblin rope snare on narrow woodland footpath, thin rope loop now exposed among swept-aside leaves, line tied to bent sapling. Credible simple device capable of lifting target ten feet. No trapped player, corpse, magical mechanism, pit or gore. Ordinary forest daylight.
prompt: Wide landscape painterly fantasy illustration of a discovered hunting-style rope loop lying FLAT ON THE GROUND in fallen leaves beside a narrow woodland footpath. Thin natural-fiber cord leads sideways to an ordinary bent sapling. This is an EMPTY fantasy-game prop, with NO PEOPLE, animals, bodies or human silhouettes anywhere. No dangling loop or suspended object. Earthy greens, brown soil, natural daylight, subtle gouache texture. No text, UI, grid or supernatural effects. Show the ground-level mechanism clearly without changing this to another trap.
